metadata.title: Our story | Liiiraa Boost
metadata.description: The story, motivation, and ambition that gave rise to Liiiraa Boost.

about.title: Our story: why Liiiraa Boost exists
about.lead: Gaming performance should not require opaque changes or a choice between speed and stability. The product begins with that conviction.

chapters.title: The problem we chose to address
chapters.body: Every PC responds differently. Generic adjustments can consume time, hide risk, and leave the player without a clear way to judge what actually changed. Liiiraa Boost exists to prepare Windows with context about the hardware and the gaming session.

chapters.title: Improve without destabilizing
chapters.body: An optimization has value only when its result can be observed and stability remains protected. Gains must therefore be treated as hypotheses to measure on the PC itself, with limits and uncertainty stated directly.

chapters.title: Trust starts on the computer
chapters.body: The work is local by default. Technical data stays on the PC, and any sharing must have a clear purpose, explicit consent, and minimum scope. The experience should explain what it intends to do before asking for a decision.

chapters.title: Control includes a way back
chapters.body: Every change should be explainable, auditable, and reversible. The previous state, the reason for the change, and the restoration path are part of optimization; they are not secondary features.

chapters.title: The long-term ambition
chapters.body: Build the definitive Windows gaming optimizer: deep enough to respect each machine, clear enough to guide decisions, and light enough not to compete with the game for the resources it promises to preserve.

metadata.title: Principles | Liiiraa Boost
metadata.description: The evidence, stability, privacy, and reversibility commitments that guide Liiiraa Boost.

principles.title: Principles behind every optimization
principles.lead: Performance matters only when it can be understood, measured on the PC itself, and pursued without hiding risk or taking control away from the player.

chapters.title: Evidence before promises
chapters.body: Gains vary with hardware, Windows, drivers, the game, and measurement conditions. The product must distinguish what was observed, estimated, or remains unproven instead of presenting hypotheses as guaranteed outcomes.

chapters.title: Stability is part of performance
chapters.body: A recommendation must respect compatibility, risk, dependencies, and the machine's limits. When evidence is not sufficient to act safely, the right choice is not to offer the adjustment.

chapters.title: Privacy starts on the PC
chapters.body: Local processing is the default. Any future sharing of technical data must have a clear purpose, minimum scope, and specific consent where applicable.

chapters.title: Control includes a way back
chapters.body: Each change must be explainable, recordable, and reversible. Review before applying, history, and restoration belong to the main experience rather than a secondary path.

records.title: More stability for gaming. Control when you need to go back.
records.summary: Liiiraa Boost analyzes your PC, prepares a hardware-aware plan, and shows what changed.
records.body: You review every adjustment before applying it, measure the result on your own computer, and keep history and restoration within reach.
limitations: Results vary with hardware, Windows, drivers, the game, and measurement conditions.
No FPS, frametime, or latency gain is promised without a valid comparison on the same PC.

evidence.scope: Analysis, review, application, comparison, and restoration journey
evidence.unprovenBoundary: The gain for each machine can only be confirmed after local measurement.

sections.title: Analyze before optimizing
sections.body: Hardware, Windows, drivers, processes, and games determine which adjustments make sense.

sections.title: Apply with a clear view of every change
sections.body: The plan explains impact, risk, dependencies, and restart needs before confirmation.

sections.title: Prove and restore
sections.body: Compare the session on the same PC and undo changes from history whenever you need to.

records.title: Results you can verify
records.summary: Proof comes from your own PC, with comparable before-and-after runs and visible conditions.
records.body: Liiiraa Boost separates measurements, estimates, and unavailable data so a hypothesis never appears as a real gain.
limitations: Valid comparisons use the same machine, game, and equivalent conditions.
A result from another computer does not guarantee yours.

evidence.scope: Benchmark, comparison, and data-source identification method
evidence.unprovenBoundary: Specific metrics remain unclaimed until local analysis is complete.

sections.title: What counts as a result
sections.body: A repeatable comparison on the same PC, with the game, version, and conditions identified.

sections.title: What never becomes a promise
sections.body: Generic estimates, marketing numbers, and incompatible measurements are not treated as gains.

records.title: See whether Liiiraa Boost fits your PC
records.summary: The app is built for Windows 10 and Windows 11 and confirms support after analyzing the machine.
records.body: Processor, graphics, drivers, storage, and games are checked before any recommendation. When safety or evidence is missing, the adjustment is not offered.
limitations: Your Windows edition and support lifecycle must be current.
ARM64, unsupported Windows versions, and unknown hardware are not automatically confirmed.

evidence.scope: Windows 10/11, local inventory, and safe refusal rules
evidence.unprovenBoundary: Support for a specific configuration depends on inventory observed by the desktop app.

supportMatrix.consequence: Analysis starts only on a Windows version inside the defined support boundary.
Confirmation happens in the desktop app using data from your own PC.
Every operation depends on valid compatibility, review, and recovery checks.
No optimization is recommended when the safe state cannot be guaranteed.
